## What this fixes

`generate-pipeline.ts` was calling `deps.fetchImpl('/api/image-generation', ...)` — an HTTP round-trip to its own sibling route — instead of invoking `ImageGenerationSeam` directly. This violated SDD's core mandate that all I/O flows through seam adapters, made the pipeline impossible to test without a running server, and baked route topology into core orchestration logic.

## Changes

- **`src/lib/core/generate-pipeline.ts`** — replace `fetchImpl` dep with `imageGenerationSeam: ImageGenerationSeam`; call `runImageGenerationPipeline()` directly instead of an HTTP fetch
- **`src/routes/api/generate/+server.ts`** — remove `fetch` from handler; inject `createImageGenerationSeam(createImageProviderConfigSeam())` into pipeline deps
- **`tests/unit/api-generate.test.ts`** — rewrite to mock the seam factory instead of `fetchImpl`
- **`tests/unit/pipeline-edge-cases.test.ts`** — replace all `fetchImpl` mock scenarios with seam-typed equivalents; replace HTTP-artifact error codes (`IMAGE_RESPONSE_INVALID`, HTTP status pass-through) with seam error codes (`IMAGE_NETWORK_ERROR`, `IMAGE_CONFIG_ERROR`, `PROVIDER_EMPTY_IMAGE`)

All 419 tests pass; 0 `svelte-check` errors.

---

## Top 10 hardest issues in this repo (as audited 2026-05-30)

1. ~~**[THIS PR] `generate-pipeline.ts` bypasses `ImageGenerationSeam` via raw `fetchImpl` HTTP call instead of direct seam injection — SDD architecture violation**~~
2. Blocked probe status for `ImageGenerationSeam` + `WigTryOnSeam` — requires `XAI_API_KEY` / `GEMINI_API_KEY` to run probes and refresh fixtures against real provider behavior
3. TODO mocks in `PromptCompilerSeam` + `GalleryStoreSeam` — mocks use inline logic instead of fixture-backed probe data; must re-probe and refactor to `createMock*(fixtures.sample)` pattern
4. Evidence freshness gap — last `docs/evidence/` directory is 2026-04-15; substantial work landed after that date with DECISIONS.md entries marked "pending"; `npm run verify` output needs to be re-captured and committed
5. Dual seam layout coexistence — 16 legacy flat-layout seams under `contracts/` / `src/lib/mocks/` / `tests/contract/` coexist with 10 self-contained seams under `src/lib/seams/`; no migration plan or tooling to retire the flat layout
6. Pure seams lack explicit verified proof — seam ledger marks pure seams as `N/A` rather than tracking that their contract tests ran; `npm run rewind` for pure seams produces no evidence artifact
7. Seam registry drift — no automated check that every `src/lib/adapters/*/index.ts` or `*.adapter.ts` file is registered in `docs/seams.md`; could silently miss unauthorized I/O
8. `Result<>` type safety inconsistency — flat-layout adapters (`meechie-tool.adapter.ts`, `session.adapter.ts`, etc.) don't use the shared `Result<V,E>` type; some throw, some return raw values, making error-handling conventions inconsistent across the codebase
9. Browser seam fixtures are stale — `auth-context`, `session`, and `creation-store` fixtures were last probed 2026-02-05 (115+ days ago); localStorage/auth shape may have drifted
10. HTTP resilience unproven — `fetchWithTimeout` / `fetchWithRetry` in `src/lib/core/http-resilience.ts` are used in production but have no integration tests for slow responses, transient failures, or max-retry exhaustion
